scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 9 boards of three live Deity Russia Religious-target games (civvis-20261110T012017Z, civvis-20261110T005727Z, civvis-20261109T231523Z), each the run's events.jsonl cut at frame 0 of a turn after the founding where a living major was unmet or under-charted: seven research turns before Cartography and two turns with a Caravel and Galleys afloat. Both arms run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch (f4ed77cac0) with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with religion-seat-charts-the-rivals. Orders differ on 2 of 9 boards, both the research choice: Bronze Working becomes Currency at t54 of 012017Z, and Celestial Navigation becomes Mathematics at t72 of 231523Z, each a step toward Buttress and Cartography. No ship order changed on the two boards with ships afloat.
